method: All own-zero-income pre-turn states in turns 0..19 of all 14 user-labelled v06 boss games, wins and losses. Fresh noise-free instances, nominal 486/36 ms vs 60000 ms, init outside clock. This is not original arena RNG/timing. Coverage reconstructed from completed comparisons and actual search order; a completed comparison covers every opponent reply. Recorded opponent actions are used only AFTER choosing for independent one-turn oracle counterfactuals. Never sum these as recoverable match points. No strength or process readiness claim.
